Check the appropriate boxes below to designate any transactions to which the statement relates:
issuer tender offer subject to Rule 13e-4.
Check the following box if the filing is a final amendment reporting the results of the tender offer: [X]
FINAL AMENDMENT TO TENDER OFFER STATEMENT
This Amendment No. 2 is being filed by the Company to report the final results of the Offer. The Offer expired at 11:59 p.m., New York City Time, on January 21, 2026. The Company accepted for purchase approximately 4,180,330 Shares at a purchase price per Share equal to the net asset value per Share as of December 31, 2025. The net asset value per Share was $18.82 per Share, resulting in an aggregate purchase price of approximately $78,673,802.
